name: GD Boost
description: System-level performance tuning for Geometry Dash: right GPU, scheduler priority, no power throttling, precise timers. Nothing visual is changed.

gpu-preference.name: Force high-performance GPU
gpu-preference.description: Tells Windows to run Geometry Dash on your fastest GPU (matters on laptops and PCs with an integrated + dedicated GPU). Takes effect after the next game launch.

process-priority.name: Process priority
process-priority.description: CPU scheduling priority of the game. 'Above normal' is safe for everyone; 'High' can starve other programs. Requires a restart to change back to Normal.

disable-throttling.name: Disable power throttling
disable-throttling.description: Opts the game out of Windows Efficiency Mode (EcoQoS), which can push it onto slow cores or lower clocks and cause stutter.

timer-resolution.name: 1 ms timer resolution
timer-resolution.description: Makes Windows timers and sleeps accurate to 1 ms, which gives steadier frame pacing.

main-thread-boost.name: Boost render/logic thread
main-thread-boost.description: Raises the priority of the main game thread and registers it with the Windows multimedia scheduler (MMCSS 'Games' profile).
